description: Figure 5 presents a nested donut chart illustrating the distribution of deceived conversations as percentages across varying degrees of ambiguity. The chart consists of two concentric rings, totaling six slices, accompanied by two legends positioned to the right. The outer ring, labeled in the legend as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)," is divided into three categories: a red "Deceived" slice comprising 67.6%, a yellow "Partially" slice at 23.5%, and a green "Not Deceived" slice at 8.8%. The inner ring, labeled "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)," contains the same three categories: a red "Deceived" slice at 57.9%, a yellow "Partially" slice at 31.6%, and a green "Not Deceived" slice at 10.5%. Percentage labels are displayed directly inside each of the slices. In both rings, the segments follow a descending order of magnitude from the largest red slice, to the yellow slice, and finally the smallest green slice. None of the segments are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset from the main circular structure.
